verdict.rationale: Galileo documents programmatic access through its own Python/TypeScript SDK, which covers logging and evaluation, and an official MCP server for creating and managing datasets, running experiments, and setting up prompt templates. That covers several workflows also offered in the console UI, but nothing documents full API-to-UI parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published REST API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented programmatic coverage of alerts, annotation queues, metric configuration and project administration, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With MCP, you can access Galileo's capabilities directly from your development environment, including: Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments, Setting up prompt templates
You can also use the `@log` decorator to log spans.
Thanks to Galileo's Python SDK we'll be able to check the application's performance and tool selection.
